notes.title: Drones To Release On 11/15
notes.notes:
Drones is here - Check out these parts features that are available in the launch release!

Enemies
15 enemies, consisting of 5 different classes and 3 different types!
Read more about the breakdown here.

Gamemodes
Work your way progressively through stages in Wave Mode to unlock harder stages, or try your hand at the endless Survival Mode to see how long you can last!

Achievements
18 Unique Steam achievements to unlock for various different tasks!

Leaderboards
10 different leaderboards to compare your highscores against your friends!

Firepower
3 Different weapon classes to unlock and use, as well as a few different types of grenades to throw - including a vampire grenade which leeches health from your enemies!

Upgrades
Give youself an advantage the next time you play by using money earned from scoring to spend on upgrades for your character. Unlock more weapons, increased damage, faster reloads and more!

Items
Pickup items while playing ranging from overloads which will give you increased damage and firepower, to standard power refills or even find more special items like a cash crate or a keycard!

Maps
5 different maps will be available to play!
